verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at developer.woocommerce.com (HTTP 200) that indexes the WooCommerce documentation files, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. Docs are also published as raw Markdown on GitHub, and a dedicated MCP feature page targets AI assistants. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or completeness (e.g. an llms-full.txt or per-page Markdown variants on the docs site), and independent or community corroboration of agents using it in practice.
